description: Check one email address now, a contact's or any other. It waits up to 10 seconds for the answer and returns the check as it is then: if `state` is still `queued`, `running` or `dispatched`, read it again with get_email_check. A check already under way for the address is returned, not started twice, and one that got no answer (`uncertain`) is sent again. A verdict stays good 30 days, and an address that already has one is not checked again. `recheck: true` checks it anyway, but never buys a new answer from the checking service less than 24 hours after the last one. A malformed address answers 400 with `params.issue`, and costs nothing. Each address a checking service answers, ours or the paid one, counts once against your plan's checks for the month; a retry after the paid service failed counts again. When none are left (a plan with no monthly limit never runs out) it answers 429 serverErrors.quotaAddressChecks, with `details.resetAt` (the 1st, 00:00 UTC) and `details.upgradeTo`. It does so whenever the call would queue a check, even one we would then answer for free, without the checking service. While the workspace's last payment has failed, the same call answers 402 serverErrors.checksPaymentFailed and queues nothing, until the workspace owner updates the card (get_billing; a manage_billing handoff asks them). At most 30 of these calls a minute per workspace.

address.description: The address alone, like ana@example.com. It doesn't need to be a contact.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

recheck.description: Check again even when the verdict is still fresh. A verdict the checking service gave in the last 24 hours comes back as it is, with no new check.

name: check_email_address
title: Check an address
